summary: First test run on Linkly MVP. 23/24 backend pytest cases passed. All frontend pages (landing, login, dashboard, links, campaigns, goals, analytics, billing) render correctly with cookie-based session auth simulation. Only failure is GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returning 500 because Stripe says 'No such checkout.session' for the freshly-created cs_test id.

critical.issue: Returns 500 -- emergentintegrations StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status fails with 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...'. Checkout creation (POST /api/payments/checkout) works and session is persisted in db.payment_transactions with payment_status=initiated, but the immediate follow-up status poll fails. Wrap call in try/except to return 'open/initiated' on Stripe 404 (for recently-created sessions) OR verify the STRIPE_API_KEY configured (sk_test_emergent) matches the one the emergent integration uses internally for creation and retrieval. Also add proper HTTPException 502 instead of letting it bubble as 500.

integration_issues.issue: Will show error state because /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns 500. Once backend Stripe polling is fixed, this flow will complete.

action_items: Fix /api/payments/status: handle Stripe 'No such checkout session' gracefully (return current db.payment_transactions.payment_status='initiated' when Stripe returns 404) instead of 500. Consider: try/except around sc.get_checkout_status and fall back to the DB record status when the session is not yet visible to Stripe retrieve API.
Verify STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent is the live/working emergent-managed key. Creation succeeds but retrieval fails, which may indicate a key mismatch or expired session.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 519: no error handling around sc.get_checkout_status -> produces 500 on any Stripe failure; wrap in try/except and return graceful status.
Backend uses a single file server.py (~680 lines). Consider splitting into routers (auth/links/analytics/payments) when the file grows beyond 700 lines per code style rule.
get_current_user: good pattern, cookie + bearer supported. expires_at parsing handles both str and datetime - OK.
POST /auth/session sets samesite='none' with secure=True which is correct for cross-site cookie (preview domain).
/api/r/{code} public endpoint properly increments clicks and logs click record; UTM params appended with lk_click=<id> - looks good.
No pagination on /api/links (to_list(1000)) and /api/analytics/overview (to_list(100000)) - fine for MVP but needs server-side aggregation later.
fraud_score heuristics are simple but reasonable for MVP.
Stripe webhook endpoint exists (POST /api/webhook/stripe) but not tested since it requires a real Stripe signature.
test_credentials: MongoDB-seeded test session: session_token='test_session_pytest_abc123', user_id='test-user-pytest', email='TEST_pytest@example.com' (cleaned up at end of run). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty. Follow /app/auth_testing.md mongosh recipe for future runs.
seed_data_creation: Ran POST /api/seed-demo during tests -> created 3 projects, 5 links, 1 goal, ~30 days of clicks (~1500) and ~5% conversions for the test user. Data was deleted in cleanup step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend almost entirely passing. Only Stripe status polling is broken (emergentintegrations Stripe 'No such checkout.session' on retrieve). Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression; re-seed a user_sessions row first via /app/auth_testing.md mongosh block. Frontend tested via cookie injection with session_token; both landing and all auth-gated routes (dashboard/links/campaigns/goals/analytics/billing) load correctly with no console errors.
rca of the issue: RCA: The checkout-status call raises CheckoutError from emergentintegrations (raise CheckoutError(f'Failed to retrieve session status: {str(e)}')) because Stripe test-mode API answered 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_a1Ua...' even though POST /api/payments/checkout returned that same cs_test id seconds earlier. Likely cause: a) the STRIPE_API_KEY used by emergentintegrations differs between create and retrieve (env rotation / shared test key pool), or b) cs_test session propagation lag. Mitigation: 1) wrap get_checkout_status in try/except and return {'status': tx.status, 'payment_status': tx.payment_status} from DB when Stripe returns 'No such checkout session'; 2) log the Stripe error and return HTTP 502 or a well-formed JSON instead of 500; 3) confirm STRIPE_API_KEY consistency. Reproduction: a) mongosh seed user_session; b) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST $URL/api/payments/checkout -d '{"plan_id":"starter","origin_url":"https://flow-track-26.preview.emergentagent.com"}'; c) curl $URL/api/payments/status/<session_id_from_b> -> 500.
